coordinates.note: Given to one arcminute (31 deg 41 min N, 110 deg 53 min W) in a Whipple collaboration paper, i.e. about 1.8 km; converted to decimal degrees. No source fetched gives the telescope pad position more precisely, so this is a site-level point, not a surveyed detector coordinate (A23).
coordinates.quote: at the Whipple Observatory on Mt. Hopkins in southern Arizona (31∘ 41’ north, 110∘ 53’ west, alt = 2300 m)

name: Whipple 10 m telescope site, Mount Hopkins
notes: The site:mount-hopkins-veritas point is the 1268 m basecamp where VERITAS stands; the 10 m telescope was on the mountain at about 2300 m.

summary.plain: The spot on Mount Hopkins in southern Arizona, about 2300 metres up, where the Whipple 10 m gamma-ray telescope stood from 1968 until 2013.
summary.technical: Whipple 10 m reflector site on Mt. Hopkins at the Fred Lawrence Whipple Observatory (31 deg 41 min N, 110 deg 53 min W, 2300 m); distinct from the 1268 m basecamp site of VERITAS.
